details.policy: typed placeholders [EMAIL]/[PHONE]/[IP]/[KEY]; code-fence, fixture (example.com, 555-, private-IP, task-content), and version-like dotted quads exempted; ML name layer intentionally skipped (Euler/Ramanujan false-positive tension documented)

details.method: 13-gram fingerprints on normalized question text. Exclusions: (1) grams in >=5 training docs (answer-format boilerplate); (2) grams shared by >=2 distinct benchmark items (problem templates). Hit = carries >=35% of one item's rare grams (>=3 grams) AND word-Jaccard(doc, item)>=0.22; short items use exact match or 8-gram Jaccard>=0.6.
